description: This source file defines functions and structures for managing and resolving a command to run the 'pi' runtime, including environment configurations, validation, and on-demand installation of necessary components.

classes.name: docsPiCommand
classes.description: Struct to encapsulate the 'pi' command executable path and arguments.

methods.name: resolveDocsPiCommand
methods.description: Resolves the command to invoke 'pi', either from environment variables, system PATH, or by ensuring the runtime is installed.

methods.name: shouldMaterializePiRuntime
methods.description: Determines if the 'pi' runtime needs to be re-installed or re-materialized based on its path.

methods.name: ensureMaterializedPiRuntime
methods.description: Performs installation of the 'pi' runtime if not already installed, handling synchronization and error reporting.

methods.name: getMaterializedPiRuntimeDir
methods.description: Returns the directory where the 'pi' runtime is installed or should be installed.

methods.name: getMaterializedPiPackageVersion
methods.description: Fetches the version of the 'pi' package to be used, defaulting if environment variable is not set.
